decisions.reason: As a close-to-core template offer launched only recently, it has no clear evidence of falling below aspiration yet and the firm's hiring, R&D, and broad portfolio give enough slack to continue testing it.

A responsive website template fits the firm's agency-focused hosting and website support business, so boundedly rational management would keep it while learning about demand rather than redeploy resources immediately.
Premium customer support is highly consistent with the firm's main value proposition of expert service and 24/7 help, making it likely to meet or exceed aspiration and be retained.
A software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical capabilities and complements managed hosting operations, so problemistic search does not yet justify dropping it.

Although this data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core business and therefore faces the highest review risk, the growing market, organisational slack, and early uncertainty still favor keeping it for another year.
